messages:
lina: Heads-up — Vendor X is rolling a firmware change that will alter inference RPC error codes (503 -> 520) starting next week. We should plan a partner-facing compatibility approach.
aj: Ack. Do we have telemetry on how many partners call that endpoint vs. marketplace connectors? rough counts will determine blast radius.
kevin: Quick numbers: 3 direct partners, marketplace connectors touch ~6 vendor integrations indirectly. Main risk: SIs that swallow specific 503 semantics will surface retries.
sasha: Proposal: implement a gateway shim that maps 520 -> 503 for a single release cycle, and expose a per-partner feature flag so we don't impact everyone. Also add analytics tags for mapped responses.
lina: Love the per-partner flag idea. Can the routing policy support it (by marketplace SKU or partner_id)?
aj: Yes — we can gate by marketplace SKU or partner_id. I'll add a boolean field in the routing config: "preserve_legacy_error_codes": true. Will also attach a metric tag like "compat_shim:vendor_x".
kevin: We need comms tailored to SIs — many inject client-side retry logic based on 503. Suggest a compatibility shielding note + a short SDK snippet to handle the new code.
sasha: Drafted a tiny shim snippet for partners to drop into client code:

```
// Backwards shim example
if (err && err.code === 520) {
  // map to legacy code so existing retry logic still works
  err.code = 503
}
```

Keep it language-agnostic in the email and link to specific SDK patches.
lina: OK. Timeline idea: enable shim + per-partner flag now, announce to partners with a 60-day deprecation window, and perform a canary rollout once vendor confirms. Canary plan: 5% traffic for 24h, 25% for 72h, then full.
aj: I'll add ops alerts: watch for retry spike, increased latency, or unusual 4xx/5xx patterns. Will create a runbook with rollback steps and PagerDuty playbook.
kevin: Marketplace action: update integration manifest to include a "compatibility_shield" boolean and add a banner on the listing about the incoming firmware change. Also prepare a one-click rollback guide for partners.
partner-bot: Draft partner notification scheduled for Tue 2025-05-20 09:00 UTC (status: draft).
lina: Action items summary: aj -> feature-flag + runbook + alerts; sasha -> gateway shim + instrumentation + PR; kevin -> partner comms + listing updates + SI playbook; lina -> coordinate vendor rollback window and legal review.
aj: I'll post the PR and runbook link in this thread when ready.
kevin: I'll loop in legal for partner notification wording and ping marketplace ops for listing slot.
sasha: Implementing shim behind a feature flag; will include a short-lived metric and a debug header "x-compat-shim" so partners can opt-in for logs.
lina: Thanks all — let's aim to have the shim and feature flag live before the vendor ship date. Posting follow-ups in #partnerships-ops if anything blocks. :thumbsup:
